question: Among patients diagnosed with SLE who have abnormal Ig M levels, find the one with the highest normal-range Ig A value and return their ID, sex, and age at the time of that laboratory test.

prediction.sql:
SELECT
    P."XCL_058" AS ID,
    P."XCL_059" AS sex,
    L."XCL_016" AS age
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P."XCL_058" = L."XCL_014"
WHERE P."XCL_064" = 'SLE'
  AND L."XCL_044" > 400
  AND L."XCL_043" BETWEEN 10 AND 400
ORDER BY L."XCL_043" DESC
LIMIT 1

    P."XCL_058" AS ID,
    P."XCL_059" AS sex,
    L."XCL_016" AS age
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P."XCL_058" = L."XCL_014"
WHERE P."XCL_064" = 'SLE'
  AND L."XCL_044" > 400
  AND L."XCL_043" BETWEEN 10 AND 400
ORDER BY L."XCL_043" DESC
LIMIT 1

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT P."XCL_058" AS ID, P."XCL_059" AS sex,
       CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', L."XCL_015") AS INTEGER) - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', P."XCL_060") AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P."XCL_058" = L."XCL_014"
WHERE P."XCL_064" = 'SLE'
  AND L."XCL_018" > 0
  AND L."XCL_017" BETWEEN 70 AND 400
ORDER BY L."XCL_017" DESC
LIMIT 1;

    p.XCL_058 AS ID,
    p.XCL_063 AS sex,
    (julianday(l.XCL_015) - julianday(p.XCL_060)) / 365.25 AS age_at_test
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.XCL_058 = l.XCL_014
JOIN Examination e ON p.XCL_058 = e.XCL_001
WHERE e.XCL_006 = 'SLE'
  AND l.XCL_021 > l.XCL_022  -- abnormal Ig M (assuming XCL_021 is Ig M value, XCL_022 is upper limit)

ORDER BY l.XCL_024 DESC
LIMIT 1
